Dialogue_Text: Thou hast come here. Thou hast come for the judgement of the Moon Sisters! We are the COSMOS that fills this place.
We are the DREAMS that give hope to the scared ones.
And finally, we are the LOVE that can cut even through the darkest nights!
Thou hast come here for a reason, but—strange. Thou art not the soul we have expected. Nay. Thou art something else.
Thou art marked with bloody tears; with fear. With chaos. Why do we see a different soul? One that shall have a different face?!
It is strange. It's almost as if you saw the true me, and not the character from this book.
This is but nonsense. I am not going to listen to this!
Silence! None of this be right!
But we are still the Moon Sisters, and we can see through the COSMOS. Thine path is marked with blood. That be enough for us to know that thine hand must be stopped.
And against those that bring nothing but death!
